Sustainable development means using only solar power.
Clean energy means it doesn't produce any smoke when burned.
Development that meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs — balancing economic, social and environmental goals.
Sustainable development means stopping all economic growth.

mcqs.q: What changed between the MDGs (Millennium Development Goals) and the SDGs (Sustainable Development Goals)?
options: MDGs and SDGs are the same — just renamed.
Sustainable development means using only solar power.
The SDGs replaced the MDGs because the MDGs were achieved.
MDGs (2000-2015) targeted LICs on basic poverty/health/education; SDGs (2015-2030) apply to all countries and include environmental and inequality goals — broader, more universal scope.

mcqs.q: Why is 'renewable' not the same as 'clean' energy?
options: Renewable means the source replenishes naturally on human timescales; clean means low environmental/health impact. Hydropower is renewable but floods habitats; bioenergy is renewable but can drive deforestation.
Clean energy means it doesn't produce any smoke when burned.
MDGs and SDGs are the same — just renamed.
All renewable energy sources are clean and have no environmental impact.
